storyParagraphs: SSVT Logistics was founded in 2009 with a single mission: to provide world-class logistics solutions for the most demanding industries on the planet. Starting with a small fleet of heavy transport vehicles and a team of experienced logistics professionals, we set out to build a company defined by precision, reliability, and an uncompromising commitment to safety.

Over 15 years, we have grown into one of the region's most trusted logistics providers, serving clients in renewable energy, oil and gas, mining, construction, power generation, and manufacturing. Our success is built on long-term partnerships with our clients, our people, and the communities in which we operate.

Today, SSVT Logistics employs over 500 professionals across our operations, project management, and support functions. We operate a fleet of 250+ specialised vehicles, manage warehousing facilities at four strategic locations, and handle cargo through partnerships with leading port operators. Our ISO-certified quality management systems and industry-leading safety record reflect our core values of excellence, integrity, and care for people and environment.

milestones.event: SSVT Logistics founded with focus on heavy transport and project logistics
Expanded into port terminal handling and freight forwarding services
Launched renewable energy logistics division, completing first major wind farm project
Expanded operations to 12 countries with 500+ team members
Named Best Logistics Provider at Asia Pacific Logistics Awards
